plan_purpose_text: This research aims to investigate the relationship between language responses and psychological processes using Spirit in Physics (Jung's Word Association Embedding Test). In this test, we record your immediate reactions to stimulus words.
plan_procedure_text: In this research, a series of words will be presented, and you will be asked to respond with the first word that comes to mind for each. Reaction times, audio, video, and physiological signals (skin potential) will also be recorded. The test takes approximately 15-20 minutes to complete.
plan_risks_text: There are no physical risks associated with participating in this research. However, some stimulus words may evoke personal emotions or memories. If you feel uncomfortable, you may discontinue the test at any time.
plan_benefits_text: There may be no direct benefits from participating in this research, but the test results may help deepen your self-understanding. Additionally, you will be contributing to the advancement of psychological research.
plan_confidentiality_text: All data collected will be anonymized and strictly protected. Your personal information will not be identified when the research results are published. Data will be stored on secure servers and will not be used for purposes other than research.
plan_voluntary_text: Participation in this research is completely voluntary. You may withdraw at any time without explaining your reasons. Refusing or discontinuing participation will not result in any disadvantages.
plan_contact_text: If you have questions or concerns about this research, please contact the research supervisor (kztainaka@bri.niigata-u.ac.jp). Phone: 025-227-0900.
